# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Business workflow mapping and FDE delivery
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Latest Articles
- [계약은 끝났는데 고객은 아직 시작을 못 하고 있나요? B2B 신규 고객 온보딩 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/customer-onboarding-automation/): How to standardize and automate B2B customer onboarding after contract signing: onboarding stages and owners, document collection, account provisioning, kickoff scheduling, first-use checks, stall alerts and where people should stay involved.
- [해외 문의·상품 정보, 매번 번역기에 복사해 붙이고 계신가요? AI 번역 자동화와 용어집·검수 기준 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-translation-glossary-workflow/): How to run AI translation for overseas inquiries and multilingual product content inside business workflows: risk-based automation levels, glossaries and style rules, rule-based checks for numbers, terms and tags, and where to place human review.
- ["이 숫자 좀 뽑아 주세요" 데이터 추출 요청, 아직 한 사람이 다 받고 계신가요? 현업 데이터 요청 처리 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/data-extraction-request-automation/): A practical guide to handling ad-hoc data extraction requests from business teams: classifying requests, turning recurring ones into scheduled extracts and self-service views, request intake forms, access control and where AI natural-language querying fits.
- [경쟁사가 요즘 어떤 사람을 뽑는지 보고 계신가요? 채용공고 데이터로 경쟁사·시장 신호 읽기 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/job-posting-data-market-signals/): How to collect job postings from official channels and turn new roles, new locations and posting volume changes into competitor and market signals, with limits and privacy rules.
- [AS 접수 전화 받고, 기사님께 카톡으로 다시 전달하고 계신가요? AS 접수·기사 배정·방문 일정 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/after-sales-service-dispatch-automation/): A practical guide to automating after-sales service and repair request handling: understanding why one customer call gets re-typed into a receptionist's memo, a technician's messenger chat and a scheduling spreadsheet, creating an AS ledger that gives every request an ID and a status from received, triaged, assigned and scheduled to visited, parts pending, completed and closed, collecting requests from phone, web forms and messenger into one intake with required fields such as product, serial number, symptom, photos, address and preferred time, letting people define technician assignment rules by region, skill, workload and warranty status while the system only narrows candidates, sending automatic visit confirmations, day-before reminders and arrival notices, having technicians report results, parts used and photos on mobile so that parts inventory and billing update from the same record, tracking revisits within a set period as a quality signal, using AI only to summarize symptoms, suggest symptom codes and draft notices while people decide warranty, cost and dispatch, and limiting access to customer addresses and contacts with retention rules checked by legal experts.
- [AI 자동화, '써 보니 괜찮던데요'로 운영해도 될까요? 평가용 테스트 세트로 정확도 검증하는 법](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-evaluation-test-set/): A practical guide to verifying AI automation quality with an evaluation test set instead of impressions from demos: understanding why a few successful trial cases hide rare but recurring exceptions and why prompt, model or rule changes can silently break previously working cases, building a simple table of real past business cases with masked personal data, an answer confirmed by the business owner before seeing AI output, case type, error severity, source period and rationale, deliberately including hard, exceptional and should-refuse cases, keeping evaluation cases separate from prompt examples, measuring per-type accuracy, critical errors, hand-off-to-human rate, format errors and time and cost rather than a single average accuracy, reading the list of wrong cases, setting pass criteria and the automatic processing scope before running the evaluation, re-running the set automatically on every change with version comparison, and feeding human-corrected production cases back into the set.
- [새 건물 들어선다는 소식, 현수막 보고 알게 되셨나요? 건축 인허가 공공데이터로 B2B 영업 기회 찾기 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/building-permit-data-sales-leads/): A practical guide to finding B2B sales opportunities with public Korean building permit data: understanding what building permit or report, construction start and use approval records each signal for sales timing, retrieving permit data through official open APIs and files on the public data portal within their terms instead of scraping, excluding information that may identify individual owners and checking contact rules with legal experts, writing a condition table of building use, floor area, construction type, region and target stage per product line, collecting daily or weekly and surfacing only new permits and stage changes into a CRM or shared sheet with data reference dates and region-based owner assignment, using fixed rules for filtering and stage detection while AI only drafts weekly summaries and marked estimates, and knowing the limits that permits do not guarantee construction, small interior works leave no records and public projects appear first in procurement notices.
- [백업은 매일 돌고 있는데, 복구는 해 보셨나요? 업무 데이터 백업·복구 점검 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/data-backup-restore-test/): A practical guide to making business data backups actually restorable: understanding why a "backup succeeded" notice can hide missing targets, unreadable copies, silently stopped jobs, copies encrypted together with the original and sync mistaken for backup, listing every system and data location with a business owner, recovery point objective (RPO), recovery time objective (RTO), backup method, retention generations, storage location and recovery runbook, checking cloud services' trash, version history and admin restore limits, separating copies with the 3-2-1 rule and keeping at least one copy outside the original accounts and permissions, automating daily backup existence and size checks and weekly test restores into an isolated environment that compare record counts, latest transaction dates and totals, running periodic human recovery drills against the RTO, treating missing alerts as a failure signal, using AI only to summarize anomalies in backup logs, suggest missing backup targets and draft runbooks, and confirming retention and deletion rules for personal and accounting data with legal and accounting experts.
- ["그거 누구한테 말하면 돼요?" 사내 IT·총무 요청, 아직 메신저로 받고 계신가요? 사내 요청 접수·처리 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/internal-request-helpdesk-automation/): A practical guide to automating internal IT and office service requests: understanding why requests for broken printers, account permissions, supplies and facility repairs get lost when they arrive through personal messengers, hallway conversations and email, listing request types with the information each one needs, a default owner, a backup owner and an agreed target handling time, keeping the messenger or groupware employees already use as the entry point while collecting every request into one numbered list with requester, type, owner, status and resolution, assigning owners with fixed rules and using AI only to turn free-text requests into form fields, ask for missing details and surface similar past cases or internal guides, never letting AI finalize permission grants, security reports or requests that cost money, notifying requesters on every status change and escalating overdue requests to backup owners or managers, and using accumulated request data to build FAQs, fix repeat equipment problems and bundle onboarding and offboarding requests.
- [제안요청서(RFP) 100쪽, 요구사항 표로 옮기는 데 며칠 걸리시나요? RFP 요구사항 추출·대응표 작성 AI 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/rfp-requirement-extraction-automation/): A practical guide to automating requirement extraction from requests for proposal (RFPs): understanding why requirements scattered across the body, annexes, evaluation tables and submission forms get missed when people copy them by hand, converting PDFs and attachments into structured text with page and section locations, having AI extract each requirement, eligibility condition, evaluation item, deadline and form with its source location and a confidence flag, building a requirement traceability matrix with ID, type, mandatory level, owner, response section and compliance status, routing low-confidence items, ambiguous wording and contract or legal clauses to human review and experts, reflecting addenda and Q&A answers as versioned changes, and reusing the matrix as the pre-submission checklist and as a record for the next bid.
